summary: Short Witton Road kerb with no stopping sign and houses beside it.

drivers.seclusion: Houses with a pool sit 12 to 20 m off the east kerb; no screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside a through lane; narrow footpath verge, no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with two lanes of traffic.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign; no cars parked along the kerb in Esri.

flags: Steep: about 3.9% mean grade over a 10 m stretch
Houses seen in imagery though OSM tags them as non-dwellings
sun_shade: Open to sky; morning sun over the houses, afternoon sun from the west.
